known_caveats: POP20 is used as the allocation weight for split precincts in place of the VAP that docs/redistricting-change-plan.md specifies. The substitution binds only on precincts straddling a district line (median unsplit_share 0.791 in the Virginia pilot) and is recorded as a declared limitation, not as done. Census-published interior points (INTPTLAT20/INTPTLON20) are used rather than computed centroids.
